crossRefs.note: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

parallels.note: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

translations.web: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
translations.bsb: Again He asked, “To what can I compare the kingdom of God?
translations.kjv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
translations.asv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
